Founder's Office - Strategy & Operations
Cuemath
Bengaluru, Karnataka, India (On-site)

About Cuemath:
Cuemath is a global math learning platform backed by top venture capital firms.

Role Overview:
We are looking for a relentless generalist to join the Founder's Office. You will tackle zero-to-one business problems, drive operational scaling, and launch new market initiatives.

Responsibilities:
• Work directly with the Founders and executive team on strategic initiatives and execution.
• Conduct market sizing, competitive analysis, and financial modeling for new business bets.
• Optimize business operations, sales funnels, and customer retention metrics.
• Deploy AI tools and automated workflows to increase organizational efficiency.

Requirements:
• 1 to 3 years of experience in founder's office, bizops, management consulting, or early-stage startups.
• High ownership mindset, generalist problem solver, and strong cross-functional execution skills.
• Proficiency in SQL, Python, or spreadsheet financial modeling.
• Bachelor's degree required.
